questions.question: Ssenariy: `us-east-1` va `eu-west-1` bo'ylab konfliktsiz replikatsiyali multi-region active-active web ilovani loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Global ingress: Global Accelerator / Route 53 latency-based routing foydalanuvchini eng yaqin region ALB'siga yuboradi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: CloudWatch Logs va S3 API chaqiruvlari sababli oylik hisob kutilmaganda $50,000 ga oshdi. Qanday tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Tekshiruv: Cost Explorer va CUR'ni Usage Type bo'yicha filtrlab, verbose DEBUG log yozayotgan servislarni topish.

questions.question: PostgreSQL uchun RPO < 1 daqiqa va RTO < 5 daqiqa bo'lgan avtomatik DR failover tizimini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: DB: primary (us-east-1) va DR (us-west-2) bo'ylab Aurora Global Database — storage replikatsiya lag ~1 soniyadan kam (RPO talabi bajariladi).

questions.question: Yuzlab firewall appliance boshqarmasdan zero-trust cloud tarmoq segmentatsiyasini qanday qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Transit Gateway'ga ulangan markaziy inspection VPC'da AWS Network Firewall, qo'shimcha ravishda VPC Lattice va service mesh (Istio) mTLS — servislar orasida identity asosidagi L7 kirish nazorati.

questions.question: EKS Managed Node Group, Self-Managed Node Group va Karpenter farqi.
questions.explanation: Self-managed: ASG, AMI va rolling update — hammasi qo'lda.

questions.question: On-prem data center'ni AWS VPC'lariga avtomatik failover bilan qanday xavfsiz ulaysiz?
questions.explanation: Asosiy: Direct Connect + Direct Connect Gateway → Transit Gateway.

questions.question: Cloud Spanner global consistency'ga qanday erishadi?
questions.explanation: TrueTime API (har data center'da atom soat va GPS) soat noaniqligini cheklaydi (ε ~ bir necha ms). Commit "commit wait" bilan noaniqlik o'tguncha kutadi va monoton commit timestamp beradi — global external consistency...

questions.question: Enterprise AWS multi-account tuzilmasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: [ Root Management Account ]

questions.question: Azure Confidential Computing va AWS Nitro Enclaves nima?
questions.explanation: Hardware bilan izolyatsiyalangan TEE: doimiy storage yo'q, interaktiv kirish (SSH) yo'q, tashqi tarmoq yo'q, faqat vsock orqali ulanadi — kriptografik kalit, PII va maxfiy ML modellarni qayta ishlash uchun.

questions.question: Ssenariy: muhandis prod security group'da 22-portni `0.0.0.0/0` ga ochib qo'ydi. 30 soniyada qanday aniqlab avtomatik tuzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Aniqlash: AWS Config incoming-ssh-disabled qoidasi (yoki to'g'ridan-to'g'ri CloudTrail AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress event'i).

questions.question: AWS Graviton nima va unit economics'ni qanday yaxshilaydi?
questions.explanation: AWS'ning ARM64 protsessorlari (Graviton3/4): ekvivalent x86 instance'larga nisbatan ~40% gacha yaxshi price-performance va kam energiya. Multi-arch image talab qiladi.

questions.question: AWS Nitro System nima?
questions.explanation: Virtualizatsiya va xavfsizlik funksiyalarini (tarmoq, storage, monitoring) maxsus hardware kartalarga o'tkazadigan yengil hypervisor — host CPU/RAM deyarli to'liq mijozga.

questions.question: EBS Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) nima?
questions.explanation: Snapshot'dan yaratilgan volume'da birinchi o'qishdagi lazy-loading kechikishini yo'qotadi — block'lar darhol to'liq unumdorlikda.

questions.question: Aurora Global Database write forwarding nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa region'dagi read-only secondary klaster SQL yozuvlarini qabul qilib, ularni primary region'dagi writer'ga avtomatik uzatadi (latency qo'shiladi).

questions.question: DynamoDB Streams nima va Lambda bilan qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Jadvaldagi element o'zgarishlarining (insert/update/delete) tartiblangan log'i (24 soat). Lambda stream'ni o'qib asinxron event-driven ishlov beradi (search index yangilash, bildirishnoma).

questions.question: DynamoDB Global Tables nima?
questions.explanation: Jadvallarni tanlangan region'lar bo'ylab multi-active replikatsiya qiladi; yozuv konfliktlari Last-Write-Wins bilan hal qilinadi.

questions.question: ElastiCache Redis va Memcached farqi.
questions.explanation: Redis/Valkey: boy strukturalar (hash, sorted set), persistence, Pub/Sub, replikatsiya, avtomatik failover.

questions.question: Amazon OpenSearch Service nima?
questions.explanation: Elasticsearch'dan ajralib chiqqan OpenSearch asosidagi boshqariladigan qidiruv va analitika: ilova qidiruvi, log analitika, time-series.

questions.question: AWS DMS nima?
questions.explanation: DB'larni AWS'ga ko'chiradigan servis; CDC bilan uzluksiz replikatsiya — cutover paytida minimal downtime.

questions.question: AWS DataSync nima?
questions.explanation: On-prem storage va S3/EFS/FSx o'rtasida terabaytlab ma'lumotni DX yoki VPN orqali avtomatik va tez ko'chirish servisi.

questions.question: FSx for Lustre nima?
questions.explanation: ML training, HPC, rendering uchun sub-ms latency va juda yuqori throughput'li boshqariladigan POSIX fayl tizimi (S3 bilan integratsiya).

questions.question: AWS Backup nima?
questions.explanation: EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, EFS, S3 bo'ylab deklarativ backup plan va avtomatik cross-region/cross-account nusxa bilan markaziy backup servisi.

questions.question: Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall nima?
questions.explanation: VPC resurslaridan zararli domenlarga yoki DNS tunneling orqali exfiltration'ga chiquvchi DNS so'rovlarini filtrlaydigan firewall.

questions.question: AWS WAF Managed Rule Groups nima?
questions.explanation: AWS va hamkorlar yuritadigan tayyor qoida to'plamlari (Core Rule Set, Known Bad Inputs, SQLi, Bot Control) — bir bosishda qo'llanadi.

questions.question: IAM permission boundary nima?
questions.explanation: Identity-based policy berishi mumkin bo'lgan maksimal ruxsatni belgilaydigan managed policy — dasturchilar role yaratganda o'z huquqini oshira olmaydi.

questions.question: KMS multi-region keys nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil key material va Key ID bilan boshqa region'larga replikatsiya qilinadigan kalit — shifrlangan ma'lumotni qayta shifrlamasdan boshqa region'da ochish.

questions.question: Secrets Manager avtomatik rotation qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Har N kunda Lambda chaqiriladi: yangi parol yaratadi, DB'ga qo'llaydi va secret'ni yangilaydi (AWSCURRENT/AWSPENDING bosqichlari) — downtime'siz.

questions.question: AWS RAM (Resource Access Manager) nima?
questions.explanation: Organization ichida akkauntlar o'rtasida resurslarni (Transit Gateway, subnet) xavfsiz ulashish servisi.

questions.question: VPC Flow Logs nima va qanday tahlil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: VPC'dagi ENI'larga kiruvchi/chiquvchi IP trafik ma'lumotlarini (5-tuple, ACCEPT/REJECT) yozadi; CloudWatch Logs yoki S3'ga, Athena SQL bilan tahlil (payload yo'q).

questions.question: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection nima?
questions.explanation: ML bilan xarajatni doimiy kuzatib, g'ayrioddiy sakrashlarni aniqlaydi va sababi bilan email/Slack alert yuboradi.

questions.question: AWS Compute Optimizer nima?
questions.explanation: Tarixiy CloudWatch metrikalarini tahlil qilib optimal EC2 turi, EBS konfiguratsiyasi va Lambda xotirasini tavsiya qiluvchi ML servis.

questions.question: Cloud Custodian YAML policy tuzilishi qanday?
questions.explanation: resource (ec2), filters (tag:Environment: absent) va actions (stop, notify) — compliance va xarajat governance'ini avtomatlashtirish.

questions.question: AWS Health Dashboard nima?
questions.explanation: AWS'dagi hodisalar sizning aniq resurslaringizga ta'sir qilganda shaxsiy ogohlantirish va tuzatish yo'riqnomasi beradi (EventBridge bilan avtomatlashtirish mumkin).

questions.question: AWS X-Ray nima?
questions.explanation: Mikroservislar bo'ylab telemetriya yig'ib service graph yaratadigan va bottleneck'larni ko'rsatadigan distributed tracing servisi (bugun OTel bilan ishlatiladi).

questions.question: Amazon Managed Grafana (AMG) va Managed Prometheus (AMP) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS'dagi to'liq boshqariladigan, yuqori mavjud serverless Prometheus storage va Grafana vizualizatsiya servislari.

questions.question: AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS workload'lariga nazoratli nosozliklar (CPU stress, latency, AZ uzilishi) kiritadigan boshqariladigan chaos engineering servisi; stop condition'lar bilan.

questions.question: AWS CodeArtifact nima?
questions.explanation: npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet paketlarini private saqlash va upstream proxy qiluvchi boshqariladigan artifact repo.

questions.question: Amazon Bedrock nima?
questions.explanation: Yetakchi AI kompaniyalarining foundation model'larini bitta API orqali taqdim etadigan boshqariladigan servis — xavfsizlik, maxfiylik va guardrail'lar bilan.

questions.question: AWS Private CA nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki servislar va IoT uchun private X.509 TLS sertifikatlarini chiqarish va yangilashni avtomatlashtiradigan boshqariladigan private CA.

questions.question: AWS AppConfig nima?
questions.explanation: Systems Manager imkoniyati: ilova konfiguratsiyasi va feature flag'larni validatsiya va alarm bo'yicha avtomatik rollback bilan dinamik deploy qilish.

questions.question: Amazon Athena nima?
questions.explanation: S3'dagi petabaytlab ma'lumotni DB infrasisiz standart SQL bilan tahlil qiladigan serverless so'rov servisi (skanerlangan bayt uchun to'lov — Parquet va partition'lar bilan arzonlashadi).

questions.question: AWS Glue va Glue Data Catalog nima?
questions.explanation: Analitika uchun ma'lumotni topish, tayyorlash va birlashtirishni avtomatlashtiradigan serverless ETL servisi. Data Catalog — jadval ta'riflari uchun markaziy metadata ombori (Athena, Redshift Spectrum ishlatadi).

questions.question: Amazon Redshift nima?
questions.explanation: Columnar storage va MPP bilan murakkab analitik so'rovlarni bajaradigan petabayt hajmli boshqariladigan data warehouse.

questions.question: Lambda Function URL nima?
questions.explanation: Lambda uchun maxsus HTTP(S) endpoint — API Gateway yoki ALB'siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri web chaqiruv.

questions.question: Lambda Extensions API nima?
questions.explanation: Lambda execution environment ichida yordamchi process ishga tushirib, monitoring va xavfsizlik tool'lari (Datadog, Dynatrace) bilan integratsiya.

questions.question: Serverless Express / Mangum nima?
questions.explanation: Oddiy Express (Node.js) yoki FastAPI/ASGI (Python) ilovalarni API Gateway ortida Lambda'da ishlatish uchun adapter'lar.

questions.question: SQS long polling va short polling farqi.
questions.explanation: Short: SQS serverlarining bir qismini so'rab darhol qaytadi, navbat bo'sh bo'lsa ham (bo'sh javoblar uchun to'lov).

questions.question: SQS visibility timeout nima?
questions.explanation: Worker xabarni olgandan keyin u boshqa consumer'lardan yashiriladigan davr. Consumer o'chirmasdan yiqilsa, xabar yana ko'rinadi va boshqasi qayta urinadi — shu sababli ishlov idempotent bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: SQS DLQ redrive policy nima?
questions.explanation: maxReceiveCount muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishdan keyin xabar DLQ'ga yuboriladi; bug tuzatilgach redrive bilan asl navbatga qaytariladi.

questions.question: SNS message filtering nima?
questions.explanation: Subscriber'lar JSON filter policy e'lon qiladi va faqat mos atributli xabarlarni oladi — keraksiz Lambda chaqiruvlari yo'qoladi.

questions.question: EventBridge Schema Registry nima?
questions.explanation: Event sxemalarini (OpenAPI, JSONSchema) saqlaydi va Python, Java, TypeScript uchun tipli kod binding'larini generatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: AWS AppSync nima?
questions.explanation: Real-time subscription, offline qo'llov va cache'ga ega boshqariladigan GraphQL va Pub/Sub API servisi.

questions.question: Elastic Beanstalk va App Runner farqi.
questions.explanation: Beanstalk: ostidagi EC2, ASG va load balancer'larni yaratib ko'rsatadi (ko'proq nazorat).

questions.question: AWS Batch nima?
questions.explanation: Containerlashgan batch job'larni dinamik EC2 va Spot fleet'larida rejalashtirib bajaradigan boshqariladigan servis.

questions.question: CloudFormation StackSets nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta operatsiyada bir nechta akkaunt va region bo'ylab stack'larni yaratish, yangilash yoki o'chirish.

questions.question: CloudFormation drift detection nima?
questions.explanation: Infra CloudFormation'dan tashqarida qo'lda o'zgartirilganini aniqlaydi.

questions.question: CloudFormation custom resource nima?
questions.explanation: Stack provision paytida Lambda chaqirib custom kod bajarish (DB to'ldirish, tashqi API chaqirish).

questions.question: VPC Reachability Analyzer nima?
questions.explanation: Real paket yubormasdan VPC resurslari orasidagi tarmoq yo'lini konfiguratsiya bo'yicha formal tekshiradi va qaysi komponent bloklayotganini ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: AWS Network Access Analyzer nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq arxitekturasi segmentatsiya siyosatlariga mosligini tekshiradi (masalan, DB subnet'larida internetga yo'l yo'qligini).

questions.question: Global Accelerator va CloudFront farqi.
questions.explanation: CloudFront: HTTP/HTTPS kontent va media'ni edge'da cache'laydi.

questions.question: AWS Transfer Family nima?
questions.explanation: S3 yoki EFS'ga SFTP, FTPS, FTP orqali fayl uzatish uchun boshqariladigan servis.

questions.question: Amazon MQ nima?
questions.explanation: ActiveMQ va RabbitMQ uchun boshqariladigan broker — legacy enterprise tizimlarni cloud'ga ko'chirish uchun.

questions.question: Kinesis Data Streams va SQS farqi.
questions.explanation: SQS: alohida xabarlar navbati; o'qilgan xabar o'chiriladi; mustaqil worker'lar.

questions.question: Kinesis Data Firehose nima?
questions.explanation: Streaming ma'lumotni qabul qilib, transformatsiya qilib, S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, Splunk'ga deyarli real vaqtda avtomatik yuklaydigan boshqariladigan ETL.

questions.question: AWS Glue DataBrew nima?
questions.explanation: + tayyor transformatsiya bilan kod yozmasdan ma'lumotni vizual tozalash va normallashtirish tool'i.

questions.question: AWS Lake Formation nima?
questions.explanation: S3'da data lake qurish va himoyalashni soddalashtiradi: markaziy ustun va qator darajasidagi nozik kirish nazorati.

questions.question: Amazon QuickSight nima?
questions.explanation: ML insight'lari va interaktiv dashboard'larga ega serverless BI servisi.

questions.question: AWS Managed Microsoft AD nima?
questions.explanation: AWS'da haqiqiy Windows Server domain controller'larida ishlaydigan boshqariladigan Active Directory.

questions.question: IAM Identity Center'da SCIM nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi IdP'dan (Okta, Entra ID) foydalanuvchi va guruhlarni IAM Identity Center'ga SCIM protokoli orqali avtomatik sinxronlash (provisioning/deprovisioning).

questions.question: Cognito User Pools va Identity Pools farqi.
questions.explanation: User Pools: web/mobil ilovalar uchun ro'yxatdan o'tish, kirish va MFA beruvchi user directory.

questions.question: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) nima?
questions.explanation: Fizik, virtual yoki cloud serverlarning disklarini block darajasida AWS'ga uzluksiz replikatsiya qilib, avariyada daqiqalarda failover qiladi (CloudEndure vorisi).

questions.question: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) nima?
questions.explanation: Lift-and-shift migratsiya uchun asosiy servis — block darajasida uzluksiz replikatsiya, minimal downtime bilan cutover.

questions.question: AWS Migration Hub nima?
questions.explanation: Turli AWS va hamkor tool'lari bo'ylab migratsiya jarayonini kuzatish uchun markaziy joy.

questions.question: AWS Well-Architected Framework nima?
questions.explanation: Oltita ustun: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability.

questions.question: AWS Well-Architected Tool nima?
questions.explanation: Konsoldagi servis: workload'ni best practice'larga nisbatan muntazam review qilib, tuzatish rejasi tuzadi.

questions.question: AWS Trusted Advisor nima?
questions.explanation: Xarajat, unumdorlik, xavfsizlik, fault tolerance va service quota bo'yicha real vaqt tavsiyalari beruvchi avtomatik tool.

questions.question: AWS Service Quotas nima?
questions.explanation: Akkaunt va region'lar bo'yicha servis limitlarini ko'rish va oshirishni so'rash uchun markaziy servis (limitlar kutilmagan outage sababi bo'lishi mumkin — monitoring qiling).

questions.question: AWS Budgets nima?
questions.explanation: Xarajat va foydalanish limitlarini o'rnatib, haqiqiy yoki prognoz sarf oshganda email/SNS alert (va avtomatik action) beruvchi servis.

questions.question: AWS Cost Categories nima?
questions.explanation: Tag'lar asosida qoidalar bilan xarajatni custom kategoriyalarga (biznes birlik, loyiha, jamoa) guruhlash.

questions.question: Athena Federated Query nima?
questions.explanation: Lambda connector'lar orqali S3 bilan birga DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis kabi manbalarga ham SQL so'rov.

questions.question: AWS Clean Rooms nima?
questions.explanation: Kompaniyalarga xom mijoz yozuvlarini bir-biriga ko'rsatmasdan birgalikdagi dataset'ni xavfsiz tahlil qilish imkonini beradi.

questions.question: AWS Audit Manager nima?
questions.explanation: AWS foydalanishini uzluksiz audit qilib, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS kabi standartlar bo'yicha compliance hisobotini soddalashtiradi.

questions.question: Amazon Q Developer (avval CodeWhisperer) nima?
questions.explanation: IDE va CLI'da kod tavsiyasi, unit test yozish va xavfsizlik skanini bajaradigan generativ AI kodlash yordamchisi.

questions.question: AWS SimSpace Weaver nima?
questions.explanation: Taqsimlangan compute'da katta miqyosli fazoviy simulyatsiyalar (butun shahar modeli) qurish servisi.

questions.question: AWS Wickr nima?
questions.explanation: End-to-end shifrlangan korporativ xabar, qo'ng'iroq va fayl almashish servisi.

questions.question: AWS Data Exchange nima?
questions.explanation: Minglab tijoriy provayderlardan third-party ma'lumotni topish, obuna bo'lish va cloud'da ishlatish servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Kendra nima?
questions.explanation: Tabiiy til so'rovlari bilan strukturasiz korporativ hujjatlarda qidiradigan ML asosidagi qidiruv servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Lex nima?
questions.explanation: NLU va nutqni tanish bilan chatbot (suhbat interfeysi) qurish servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Polly nima?
questions.explanation: Matnni tabiiy nutqqa aylantiradigan deep learning servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Rekognition nima?
questions.explanation: Rasm va videoda obyekt, yuz, matn va nomaqbul kontentni aniqlaydigan computer vision servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Transcribe nima?
questions.explanation: Nutqni timestamp va so'zlovchini aniqlash bilan matnga aylantiradigan ASR servisi.

questions.question: Amazon Comprehend nima?
questions.explanation: Strukturasiz matndan insight, sentiment va kalit iboralarni ajratadigan NLP servisi.

questions.question: Amazon SageMaker nima?
questions.explanation: ML modellarni build, train, tune va deploy qilish uchun boshqariladigan platforma.

questions.question: SageMaker JumpStart nima?
questions.explanation: Oldindan o'qitilgan foundation model'lar hub'i — bir bosishda baholash va deploy.

questions.question: AWS Panorama nima?
questions.explanation: Mavjud on-prem IP kameralarga computer vision olib keluvchi qurilma va SDK — edge'da inspeksiyani avtomatlashtirish.

questions.question: AWS IoT Core nima?
questions.explanation: IoT qurilmalarni MQTT, HTTP, WebSocket orqali cloud ilovalari bilan xavfsiz bog'laydigan boshqariladigan platforma.

questions.question: AWS IoT Greengrass nima?
questions.explanation: Edge'da qurilma dasturini qurish, deploy va boshqarish uchun ochiq edge runtime va cloud servis.

questions.question: AWS Outposts nima?
questions.explanation: Fizik AWS infrasini (server va rack) on-prem data center'ga yetkazadigan boshqariladigan servis — gibrid uchun bir xil API.

questions.question: AWS Wavelength nima?
questions.explanation: AWS compute va storage'ni 5G operator tarmoqlari ichiga joylashtirib, mobil qurilmalar uchun ultra past latency beradi.

questions.question: Snowcone, Snowball va Snowmobile nima?

questions.explanation: Public subnet: ALB va NAT Gateway.

questions.question: Ssenariy: API'ga 500,000 req/s dan ortiq DDoS hujumi. AWS'da qanday himoyalanasiz?
questions.explanation: ALB oldiga CloudFront + Shield — L3/L4 SYN/UDP flood global edge'da yutiladi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: on-prem Oracle'ni Aurora PostgreSQL'ga minimal downtime bilan qanday ko'chirasiz?
questions.explanation: Schema konversiya: AWS SCT bilan PL/SQL, trigger va sxemani PostgreSQL DDL'ga.

questions.question: Ssenariy: statik credential'siz cross-account IAM kirishni qanday xavfsiz qilasiz?
questions.explanation: B akkauntda (target): trust policy'da Principal: { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::AccountA:root" } (yoki aniq role ARN) va confused deputy'ga qarshi sts:ExternalId sharti bilan IAM role.

questions.question: Ssenariy: private subnet'dagi EC2 GitHub'dan yangilanish yuklay olmayapti. Qanday troubleshoot qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Route table: private subnet'da 0.0.0.0/0 faol NAT Gateway ga yo'naltirilganmi.

questions.question: Ssenariy: public access o'chirilgan S3 bucket'ga tashqi ruxsatsiz IP'dan kirilgan. Qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Athena'da CloudTrail (S3 data events yoqilgan bo'lishi kerak) log'larini eventSource = 's3.amazonaws.com' va bucket nomi bo'yicha so'rash.

questions.question: Ssenariy: DynamoDB'da yuqori latency sabablari va yechimlari.
questions.explanation: Hot partition: yuk bitta partition key'ga to'planadi. Yechim: key'ga tasodifiy suffix (salting), yaxshiroq key dizayni.

questions.question: Ssenariy: 100 ta AWS akkauntda ishlatilmayotgan resurslarni avtomatik tozalashni qanday qilasiz?

questions.question: NACL'da ephemeral portlar nima uchun muhim?
questions.explanation: Private subnet'dagi client internetga ulanganda javob trafigi ephemeral portga (1024-65535) qaytadi. NACL stateless bo'lgani uchun bu portlarga kiruvchi trafikni aniq ruxsat qilish kerak.

questions.question: Direct Connect Public VIF, Private VIF va Transit VIF farqi.
questions.explanation: Public VIF: public AWS servislariga (S3, DynamoDB) DX orqali internetsiz.

questions.question: Local Zones va Wavelength farqi.
questions.explanation: Local Zones: latency'ga sezgir korporativ ilovalar uchun shaharlarda joylashgan AWS infra.

questions.question: Snowball Edge Compute Optimized nima?
questions.explanation: Uzilgan edge muhitlarda (kema, neft platformasi) ML inference va analitika bajarish uchun ko'p vCPU, katta RAM va ixtiyoriy GPU'ga ega mustahkam qurilma.

questions.question: S3 uchun PrivateLink (Interface Endpoint) nima?
questions.explanation: S3'ga subnet'ingizdan private IP beradi — on-prem data center DX orqali S3'ga public IP'siz kira oladi (Gateway endpoint'dan farqli).

questions.question: IAM session policy nima?
questions.explanation: sts:AssumeRole paytida uzatiladigan qo'shimcha policy — o'sha sessiya uchun role ruxsatlarini yanada cheklaydi (kengaytira olmaydi).

questions.question: KMS envelope encryption'da DEK lifecycle qanday?
questions.explanation: KMS GenerateDataKey → plaintext DEK va shifrlangan DEK.

questions.question: Secrets Manager rotation Lambda arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Ko'p bosqichli workflow: createSecret → setSecret (DB parolini yangilaydi) → testSecret (yangi login'ni tekshiradi) → finishSecret (yangi versiyani AWSCURRENT qiladi).

questions.question: EBS Elastic Volumes nima?
questions.explanation: Ishlab turgan EC2'da volume hajmi, IOPS va turini downtime'siz va detach qilmasdan o'zgartirish (keyin fayl tizimini growpart/resize2fs/xfs_growfs bilan kengaytirish kerak).

questions.question: RDS Multi-AZ va Multi-Region farqi.
questions.explanation: Multi-AZ: shu region'dagi boshqa AZ'da sinxron standby — avtomatik HA, odatda ~1-2 daqiqada failover.

questions.question: RDS read replica lag nima?
questions.explanation: Primary va read replica orasidagi asinxron replikatsiya kechikishi; CloudWatch ReplicaLag metrikasi bilan o'lchanadi.

questions.question: ElastiCache cluster mode enabled va disabled farqi.
questions.explanation: Disabled: bitta shard — 1 primary va 5 tagacha replica (yozish bitta node bilan cheklangan).

questions.question: DynamoDB TTL nima?
questions.explanation: Belgilangan timestamp atributi o'tgan elementlarni avtomatik o'chirish uchun belgilaydi; odatda 48 soat ichida, WCU sarflamasdan o'chiriladi (shuning uchun so'rovda filtr qiling).

questions.question: DynamoDB transactions nima?
questions.explanation: Bir yoki bir nechta jadvaldagi ko'p elementlar bo'ylab ACID kafolatli operatsiya (TransactWriteItems, TransactGetItems).

questions.question: S3 Batch Operations nima?
questions.explanation: Milliardlab obyekt ustida katta batch operatsiyalar (tag, ACL, copy, Lambda chaqirish) bajaradigan boshqariladigan funksiya.

questions.question: S3 Storage Lens nima?
questions.explanation: Tashkilot bo'ylab object storage foydalanishi, xarajat optimallashtirish imkoniyatlari va xavfsizlik holatini ko'rsatadigan analitika.

questions.question: CloudFront field-level encryption nima?
questions.explanation: Formalardagi sezgir maydonlarni (karta raqami) edge'da public key bilan shifrlaydi — backend'ning faqat kerakli qismi ocha oladi.

questions.question: CloudFront Functions va Lambda@Edge farqi.
questions.explanation: CloudFront Functions: yengil JS, sub-ms, barcha edge'larda (URL rewrite, header, token tekshiruvi).

questions.question: Route 53 Traffic Flow nima?
questions.explanation: Geolocation, latency va failover qoidalarini birlashtirgan murakkab routing topologiyasini vizual tahrirlash vositasi.

questions.question: Route 53 DNSSEC nima?
questions.explanation: Public hosted zone yozuvlariga kriptografik imzo qo'shadi — DNS spoofing va cache poisoning'dan himoya.

questions.question: API Gateway REST API va HTTP API farqi.
questions.explanation: HTTP API: serverless uchun yengil, past latency va ~70% arzonroq.

questions.question: API Gateway WebSocket API nima?
questions.explanation: Brauzer va backend (Lambda/SQS) orasida doimiy ikki tomonlama ulanish — chat, jonli bildirishnomalar uchun.

questions.question: Lambda DLQ nima?
questions.explanation: Asinxron chaqiruv 2 marta qayta urinishdan keyin ham yiqilsa event'ni SQS yoki SNS'ga yuboradi — ma'lumot yo'qolmaydi (bugun "on-failure destination" afzal).

questions.question: Lambda Layers nima?
questions.explanation: Custom runtime, umumiy kutubxona yoki dependency'larni o'z ichiga olgan qayta ishlatiluvchi ZIP — /opt ga mount qilinadi.

questions.question: Lambda container image nima?
questions.explanation: Lambda'ni 10GB gacha OCI image sifatida paketlash — katta dependency va custom runtime uchun.

questions.question: AppConfig feature flags nima?
questions.explanation: Dinamik konfiguratsiya va boolean/multivariant flag'larni validatsiya va alarm bo'yicha rollback bilan deploy qilish.

questions.question: SSM Patch Manager nima?
questions.explanation: Katta Linux/Windows fleet'larida patch baseline bo'yicha OS xavfsizlik patch'larini skanerlash va qo'llashni avtomatlashtiradi.

questions.question: SSM State Manager nima?
questions.explanation: Instance'larning OS konfiguratsiyasi va agent holatini kerakli holatda saqlashni avtomatlashtiradigan configuration management servisi.

questions.question: CloudFormation stack policy nima?
questions.explanation: Stack yangilanishida kritik resurslarni (masalan RDS) tasodifiy yangilash yoki o'chirishdan himoyalovchi JSON hujjat.

questions.question: CloudFormation modules nima?
questions.explanation: Resurs konfiguratsiyalarini jamoalar ulashadigan qayta ishlatiluvchi bloklarga jamlash — tashkilot standartlarini majburlash.

questions.question: IAM Roles Anywhere nima?
questions.explanation: AWS tashqarisidagi workload'lar (on-prem server, boshqa cloud'dagi pod'lar) X.509 sertifikat bilan STS orqali vaqtinchalik IAM credential oladi.

questions.question: VPC Traffic Mirroring nima?
questions.explanation: ENI'lardan xom trafikni nusxalab, deep packet inspection va IDS uchun security appliance'larga yuboradi.

questions.question: AWS Verified Access nima?
questions.explanation: Identity va qurilma xavfsizligi signallari asosida ichki web ilovalarga VPN'siz zero-trust kirish.

questions.question: GuardDuty EKS Protection nima?
questions.explanation: EKS audit log'lari va container runtime xulqini tahlil qilib buzilgan pod, privilege escalation va kripto-mayningni aniqlaydi.

questions.question: Amazon Detective nima?
questions.explanation: Flow Logs, CloudTrail va GuardDuty ma'lumotlaridan ML bilan interaktiv graf yaratib, incident root cause tekshiruvini yengillashtiradi.

questions.question: KMS asymmetric keys nima?
questions.explanation: RSA yoki ECC public/private kalit juftini ifodalovchi KMS kalitlari — imzolash, imzo tekshirish va AWS tashqarisida asimmetrik shifrlash.

questions.question: SQS deduplication ID nima?
questions.explanation: FIFO navbatda 5 daqiqalik oynada takroriy xabarlarni aniqlab tashlash uchun noyob token (yoki content-based dedup).

questions.question: EventBridge Pipes nima?
questions.explanation: Producer'larni (DynamoDB Streams, SQS, Kinesis) target'larga ixtiyoriy filter va enrichment bilan glue kodsiz ulaydigan point-to-point integratsiya.

questions.question: FinOps'da cost allocation tag'lar nima?
questions.explanation: Billing'da faollashtiriladigan user-defined tag'lar (Environment, Owner, CostCenter, Project) — xarajatni biznes birlik bo'yicha kuzatish uchun.

questions.question: Well-Architected Sustainability ustuni nima?
questions.explanation: Atrof-muhitga ta'sirni kamaytirish: hardware'dan maksimal foydalanish, Graviton protsessorlari, bo'sh compute isrofini yo'qotish.
